Author: dajoey
Name: LazyCrafter
Punchline: What can I make right now, what's it worth, and what would it take to make the rest?
Description: Catalogs every recipe you can craft, buckets them by how much effort the missing materials take, prices them with Universalis, and hands the missing-material work to Artisan / GBR / ARC / Lifestream.
Changelog:
v0.1.7.15 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- Crafts that were waiting on a material WahTools handed back no longer run into a wall of failed-craft lines in the same pass. They are pulled out of the wave's craft queue the moment the hand-back happens, their rows on the Run tab show them waiting for the next pass, and the re-plan remakes them on the material's new route.
- Crafts no longer start while WahTools Hunter is still driving the character after a hunt. The hand-off to Artisan now waits for WahTools to go idle, the same gate the other WahTools hand-offs use, and logs one line when it does.
- The blocked report now lists the fish and monster-drop materials WahTools was handed, so the Run tab and /lcraft status show what a blocked run is waiting on.
- WahTools' Hunter is now offered an item's monsters in a smarter order: the highest-level monster the character can already beat first, then monsters with no known level, then monsters above the character's combat level from the lowest up. The level data comes from the installed WahTools itself; when it cannot be read, a warning is logged once per session and the previous order is kept.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

v0.1.7.14 (2026-11-21) [testing]
- **Monster-drop materials can be hunted with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a material that a known monster drops is handed to WahTools' Hunter instead of going straight to the market-board list. Hunter counts kills, not drops, so the run hunts in batches, recounts the bags between batches, and stops as soon as enough have landed. It gives up after two batches in a row that drop nothing (or eight in total), and the rest goes back on the market-board or manual list on the next pass. Gil-vendor items, and currency-shop items the character can already pay for, are still bought, never hunted.
- **Fish materials can be caught with WahTools.** When WahTools is loaded, a fish that no gathering node yields goes to WahTools' Feesh instead of GatherBuddyReborn. A fish WahTools will not take, such as an ocean fish, goes back to GatherBuddyReborn on the next pass. The caught fish stay protected from WahTools' own discard and desynth rules until the run ends, including while a blocked run waits for Resume.
- Both run after GatherBuddyReborn and before Artisan, and crafts that need them wait for them. Each has its own setting under Dispatch behavior, both on by default; with WahTools absent or both settings off, routing is exactly as before. Stop ends a WahTools fish or hunt in progress.
- The Integrations list shows whether WahTools is loaded.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged.

- The catalog table keeps its sortable, resizable and reorderable columns and its right-click menu for showing and hiding columns; columns that do not fit start hidden.
- Numeric column headers line up with the figures beneath them in the catalog, cart, ledger and run tables, and no header is cut mid-word at larger UI scales.
- Recipe details are organised into summary, ingredient and market cards, with source and unit price under each ingredient and the fulfil buttons beside them.

Author: Akari
Name: Market Helper
Punchline: Undercut, list, gather and buy — market board automation end to end.
Description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with five tabs:

UNDERCUT — Walk a summoning bell's retainers and undercut every listed item. HQ and NQ are handled separately, your own retainers are matched rather than undercut, per-item overrides and price memory are supported, an obvious troll price is skipped, and mannequin/display items are never touched (if a row can't be verified it is skipped rather than risk delisting it). Closes the bell when it finishes.

LISTER — Build a list (hold CTRL and hover an item, or search) and press Go to list them all. Prices each item at the most common market price, ignoring lone troll listings, against your world, data center or whole region. Per-item stack sizes and list amounts, rolls extra items to the next retainer at the 20-slot cap, and includes a no-touch dry run.

FLIPPER — Compare any marketable item across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modelling.

ITEM GATHERER — Pull designated items off your retainers into your bags, optionally returning your market listings first. Manual withdraw/deposit actions included.

BUYER — Build a shopping list by hand or import a MakePlace furniture list, then SCAN the market per world via Universalis and press SEND to travel with Lifestream and buy across worlds. Every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it is accepted. Listings are bought whole, so by default it never buys a bigger stack than you still need, and a hard sanity ceiling caps the price even with no cap set. If a planned listing has already been bought it chases the next cheapest, on other worlds if needed, until your order is filled. Dry run is on by default.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

Author: yagi2
Name: Restocker
Punchline: Bulk reprice and split-list retainer market listings across all retainers.
Description: Cross-retainer market workbench with a plan-then-apply flow. Reprice tab: per-retainer 'lowest -N g' / 'lowest exact' buttons walk each listing, fetch live market data via Dalamud's IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived (skipping your own retainers, deduplicated per item/HQ), stage every change in a queue, then commit them all via a single Apply that calls SetRetainerMarketPrice directly. New listing tab: per-row qty x slots, target retainer combo, auto stack-splitting (e.g. 990 / 99 → ten listings of 99), and direct listing from character bag / Chocobo Saddlebag with no entrust step (saddle items are bulk-staged to the bag in one phase, then listed). Live progress dialog shows the current step (selecting retainer, fetching market data, listing, …) so long runs don't look frozen. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO). Warns once at startup if AutoRetainer is also loaded since both drive retainer summoning.
